s: An essay in the Virgilian group explains in a convincing way why the unfolded roll in the Virgil mosaic found at Susa carries line 8 of the Aeneid (Musa mihi, etc.) rather than the conventional Arma virumque cano: the words are better suited to the picture, as two Muses stand by Virgil's side .
